name: POLYFORGE Asset Pipeline
description: Generate an original low-poly mesh, canonicalize it into a stable-ID editable asset, bake strict budgeted LODs with measured GLB readback, and hand those levels to the runtime distance selector.

components.role: canonical editable source and stable-ID operations
offline LOD generation, GLB export, and readback

connections.note: The generated mesh initializes the canonical editable document.
Only validated source revisions are baked.
Runtime selection consumes measured levels, not authoring estimates.

acceptanceCriteria: Identical inputs produce identical canonical source and GLB bytes.
Every generated family respects targetFaceCount or fails explicitly.
Every descriptor triangle and byte count is independently read from exported GLB data.
LOD triangle counts are non-increasing and never exceed their declared budgets.
Stable-ID split and extrusion edits preserve manifold closed source meshes.
